# telnyx_porting_order_phone_number_configurations (Data Source)

The configurations of phone numbers in porting orders.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_porting_order_status` (List of String) Filter results by specific porting order statuses
- `filter_porting_phone_number` (List of String) Filter results by a list of porting phone number IDs
- `filter_user_bundle_id` (List of String) Filter results by a list of user bundle IDs
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort_value` (String) Specifies the sort order for results. If not given, results are sorted by created_at in descending order. One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `porting_order_phone_number_configurations` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--porting_order_phone_number_configurations))
